description:
Port-map §8. Tie everything together with `mix pi` (escript
deferred; mix task is fine for now).

Scope:
- Mix.Tasks.Pi — parses argv (OptionParser), resolves cwd,
  resolves model, dispatches to Print or RPC mode.
- Flags: --print/-p <prompt>, --mode rpc, --model <id>,
  --cwd <path>, --help.
- Model resolution: hardcoded claude-haiku-4-5 default; full
  config profile support deferred to Phase 8.

Definition of done:
  `mix pi --print "write hello world to foo.txt and cat it back"`
  runs end-to-end against live Anthropic, produces a session file
  readable by upstream pi.
  `mix pi --mode rpc` passes a JSON-in/JSON-out round-trip test.

TDD:
- Argv parsing unit tests (default mode is :print if no --mode)
- `mix pi --help` prints usage
- Smoke test (@tag :integration) that runs print mode with a
  trivial prompt against FakeTransport

Depends on .7, .8.
title: CLI entry + mode dispatch + end-to-end smoke
